title: A ship a run left loaded docks at Frontier Station, Altais, and stores its hold
note: Written by Oracle, 2026-11-23 03:58 UTC (orders.log ENT-071, P6; rule F8). At 03:19 UTC six Outer Rim scouts at Altais waited with 20 fuel cells aboard, a once mission's reward (one more scout held 20 fuel cells after its Who Buys Old Charts run, 03:46 UTC; where the cells come from is not read yet), so every census of theirs, which wants an empty hold, was closed to them (fill.py status: hold not empty). The third time a hold idled scouts (LEARNINGS.md 2026-11-16 twice). One stop, store all, at the newborns' capital Altais (Frontier Station): the goods go into the pilot's own storage there. Standing work at the head of the newborns' rows; a ship that carries nothing passes it by. The same as store-hold-central-nexus and Zero's store-hold-grand-exchange (Mining, 2026-11-23); requires.empire outerrim keeps every other pilot off it.
